notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Koya Rift, 10% off!
notes.notes:
Koya Rift is Now Available on Steam and is 10% off!*

In Koya Rift, the player must enter a hostile planet and destroy an alien race so the planet can be colonized. Each game, the player is dropped off at the surface and must venture into procedurally generated caves, earning upgrades and buying units as he goes along. The difficulty adjusts precisely to the skill of the player over time, providing them with a consistent challenge.

*Offer ends November 3 at 10AM Pacific Time
